content.short: Hop Aggregator is a hyperstructure-based DEX aggregator on Sui, providing optimized trades and a meme launchpad.
content.description:
Hop Aggregator is a leading DEX aggregation layer on the Sui blockchain, designed as a zero-fee hyperstructure. The platform leverages Sui's Programmable Transaction Blocks to scan multiple liquidity pools, ensuring users receive optimized trading routes with minimal slippage. It aggregates liquidity from various protocols like Cetus and Turbos, providing an efficient swapping experience for all Sui traders.

Beyond swaps, Hop features Hop.fun, a fair-launch platform for meme tokens and community projects. Its robust developer SDK allows for deep integration and fosters growth within the Sui DeFi landscape. The protocol remains focused on high-speed execution and capital efficiency, serving as a critical infrastructure component for the network.
